name: NGC 5010 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5010, a lenticular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5010-hubble
story: NGC 5010 is in a period of transition, moving on from life as a spiral galaxy toward a rounder elliptical shape. Tilted sideways to us, it shows the dusty remnant bands of its old spiral arms.

claims.text: It is in transition from spiral toward elliptical
Oriented sideways, it shows dusty remnant bands of spiral arms
